# h3_snapshot (Resource)

Manages a point-in-time snapshot of an `h3_disk`. A snapshot is immutable: every argument change creates a new one. Import with `<project_id>/<snapshot_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "h3_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  disk_id    = h3_disk.data.id
  name       = "before-upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_id` (String) ID of the disk to snapshot
- `name` (String) Snapshot name

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `id` (String) Snapshot ID
- `size` (String) Snapshot size
- `status` (String) Snapshot status (`CREATING`, `READY`, `FAILED`)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<snapshot_id>
terraform import h3_snapshot.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/<snapshot_id>
```
